note: The raw DER certificate bytes supplied as input (containing the crafted subjectAltName extension with a malformed otherName entry) enter the parser on the DER branch and are handed to the DER parsing core.

While iterating the v3 extensions, the parser matches extnID 2.5.29.17 (MBEDTLS_X509_EXT_SUBJECT_ALT_NAME) and dispatches the extnValue OCTET STRING (GeneralNames) to the subject alternative name parser.

The malformed [0] otherName entry makes mbedtls_x509_parse_subject_alt_name return an error (ASN1_OUT_OF_DATA, not FEATURE_UNAVAILABLE). The error path frees every allocated node of subject_alt_name->next but never clears subject_alt_name->next itself, leaving the head's next pointer dangling to freed heap memory.

The SAN parsing error propagates out of x509_get_crt_ext; the DER parse core treats it as a fatal parse failure and immediately calls mbedtls_x509_crt_free while crt->subject_alt_names.next is already a dangling pointer.

Certificate cleanup starts seq_cur at cert_cur->subject_alt_names.next, which still points to the freed sequence node; dereferencing seq_cur->next reads freed heap memory, followed by a zeroize write to freed memory and a double free (heap use-after-free).
